uncited: This layout defines the memory organization of the root `Octree` class, which manages the hierarchical voxel data structure.
It solves the problem of tracking the spatial bounds and storage locations of the octree nodes and associated voxel data.

It differs from its parent [Naive Octree Node Representation](2445-naive-octree-node-representation.md) by encapsulating the global tree state (bounds, node list, data pointer) in a single class, rather than focusing on the internal fields of an individual node.
The class is instantiated to manage a voxel scene.
It outputs a root node pointer and provides access to the node list and voxel data array.
The root node is stored at the end of the `nodes` vector.
The total memory is proportional to the number of nodes and data elements.
Node iteration requires traversing the `nodes` vector.
It represents a specific implementation choice for a CPU-based raycaster, prioritizing simple vector-based storage over pointer-heavy tree structures.
